description_html:
The Vaporesso ECO Nano PLUS Replacement Pod is a refillable replacement pod for compatible Vaporesso devices.

  • Product Type: Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Built-in Coil)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 10mL
  • Coil Resistance: 0.8Ω Mesh (built-in)
  • Coil Material: Integrated LUSH Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: Vaporesso ECO Nano PLUS
  • Brand: Vaporesso

Coil is built in - replace the pod when flavour fades. E-liquid sold separately.
